subject: OrionData: Exec roster & EB meeting options for MAP and close timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@oriondata.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: OrionData: Exec roster & EB meeting options for MAP and close timeline

Hi Emily / team,

Thanks again for the time on the demo yesterday — really appreciated the clear use-case notes. As promised, attached is a refreshed mutual action plan (MAP-OrionData-v2.xlsx) with milestone dates mapped to the close timeline.

Next steps we need to lock in from the Redwood side:
- Confirm exec sponsor(s) from Orion for the executive briefing (EB) — names and roles so we bring the right attendees.
- Book a 30-min EB to review the MAP, alignment on success criteria, and the 6-week evaluation plan.
- Identify procurement and legal contacts so we can circulate the contract redline window.

Proposed EB slots (PT):
- Tue Apr 4, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Tue Apr 4, 09:30–10:00 PT
- Wed Apr 5, 09:00–09:30 PT

I pulled an initial exec roster section in the MAP (tab: Exec-Alignment) — if you can share titles for the execs we should invite (CEO/CTO/Head of ML, or a biz sponsor) I’ll tailor the slides.

Attachments: MAP-OrionData-v2.xlsx, RDW-EB-slides-30m.pdf (draft)

Thanks, and happy to adapt slots — if mornings don’t work, tell me a time window and we’ll match on our side.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-3291

From: Emily Park <emily.park@oriondata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Mendes <paul.mendes@oriondata.com>, procurement@oriondata.com
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrionData: Exec roster & EB meeting options for MAP and close timeline

Thanks Marissa — forward to the team and good summary.

Quick answers:
- Exec sponsor: Paul Mendes (CTO) will be the technical exec sponsor; he also suggested Carol Lim (Head of Data Ops) join if we discuss rollout cadence.
- Procurement lead: procurement@oriondata.com (cc’d) — they’ll own contract timeline/finalization.
- Legal review: legal@oriondata.com is the inbox for redlines.

We prefer a 30-min EB. The Apr 4 slots look promising; Paul asked if we can do Tue Apr 4, 09:30–10:00 PT. That works for him and Carol.

Before the EB, can you send a 1-pager on the evaluation plan (success metrics, data-needed, timeline) and a short list of contacts you expect from Redwood (solutions engineer, AM, contracts)? Also please include any items procurement needs to see pre-RFP (e.g., SOC2, data residency bullet).

Appreciate the MAP draft — I’ll review and propose edits inline.

Best,
Emily
Emily Park
Head of Product Partnerships | OrionData
emily.park@oriondata.com | +1 (206) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrionData: Exec roster & EB meeting options for MAP and close timeline

Marissa — quick notes to prep before we lock the EB: 

- Pricing ask: Paul will likely push for a short-term evaluation credit/POC allowance. Can you confirm a standard 8–12 week evaluation package pricing we can offer and what concessions are on the table (credits, onboarding hours)?
- SLA / performance: include a short note in the MAP on target p95 latency and failover behavior (they’ll need this for their infra team).
- Contracts: loop Priya for an initial redline window; I suggest a 10 business-day negotiation window to keep the close target in Q2.

I can join the EB as the pricing SME — also happy to do a 10-min pre-brief with procurement if they want.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Commercial | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrionData: Exec roster & EB meeting options for MAP and close timeline

Emily / Paul / procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the EB:

Final EB booking:
- Tue Apr 4, 09:30–10:00 PT — 30 minutes
- Attendees from Orion: Paul Mendes (CTO), Carol Lim (Head of Data Ops)
- Attendees from Redwood: Marissa Cole (Director, Strategic Accounts), Ben Carter (pricing lead), Karthik Iyer (solutions engineer)

Pre-EB deliverables (we’ll share these by EOD Wed Apr 3):
- 1-page Evaluation Plan (success metrics, telemetry we'll collect, test dataset scope) — RDW eval plan link included.
- Final MAP (MAP-OrionData-v2.xlsx) with exec roster and milestone owners.
- Short appendix for Procurement: SOC2 overview, data residency options, sample SLA language.

Priya — once the EB is complete, please start the initial contract playbook (10 business-day redline window recommended). Ben — please prepare a short pricing slide outlining the 8-week evaluation credit and onboarding hours.

Emily — I’ll send the calendar invite and a calendar-ICS attachment (calendar-EB-proposed.ics) now; please accept and I’ll lock rooms on our side. If the execs prefer a different slot, tell me by EOD Wed Apr 3 and we’ll adjust.

Looking forward to the EB — our objective is alignment on success metrics and a crisp evaluation window so we can hit the Q2 close target.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-3291
